patch.explanation: raw.orders has 15000 rows, but staging.stg_orders only has 7667 rows because the model filters out rows where o_orderstatus = 'O'. The failing check expects all orders to be present, indicating the filter is unintended. Removing the WHERE clause restores the full row count.
